node.statement: In the notation feeding (1.1), rho_theta=1/8, while rho_T is a minimum containing rho_theta; hence eta<=rho_T implies 0<=eta<=1/8. Therefore lem-routef-functional-calculus-closeness gives ||tilde-Phi-Phi||_cb<=C_theta*eta. Node 1.2.1 gives ||Phi||_cb<=1, so the cb-norm triangle inequality yields ||tilde-Phi||_cb<=||Phi||_cb+||tilde-Phi-Phi||_cb<=1+C_theta*eta.
